description: This file defines a global exception handler for a Spring Boot application. It maps specific exceptions like UserNotFoundException, DuplicateEmailException, and IllegalArgumentException to corresponding HTTP responses with appropriate status codes and error payloads.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring REST controller advice that handles specific application exceptions and converts them into HTTP responses with detailed error information.

methods.name: errorPayload
methods.description: Creates an ApiError object containing timestamp, status code, reason phrase, message, and request URI for error responses.

methods.name: handleUserNotFound
methods.description: Handles UserNotFoundException and returns a 404 Not Found response.

methods.name: handleDuplicateEmail
methods.description: Handles DuplicateEmailException and returns a 409 Conflict response.

methods.name: handleIllegalArgument
methods.description: Handles IllegalArgumentException and returns a 400 Bad Request response.
